Plot example cell log ratios

plot_cell_log_ratios.Rd

Plots gene-level and chromosome arm-level log ratio profiles for a selected cell.

Gene expression values are centred relative to a reference population and displayed across the genome together with chromosome arm-level log ratio values.

Usage

plot_cell_log_ratios(xenium.obj, cell_id, arm_ratios, reference_groups)

Arguments

xenium.obj

Normalised Xenium object

cell_id

Cell identifier to plot

arm_ratios

Matrix of chromosome arm log ratio values generated by compute_arm_ratios().

reference_groups

Groups used to construct the reference population for gene-level log ratio calculation.

Value

A ggplot2 object showing gene-level and chromosome arm-level log-ratio profiles for a selected cell.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Plot example log ratio cell profile
plot_cell_log_ratios(xenium.obj = xenium.obj,
                    cell_id = "aamfeehk-1",
                    arm_ratios = arm_ratios,
                    reference_groups = c("Fallopian Tube Epithelium",
                    "Secretory Epithelial Cells"))} # }
